title: Slime Spirit Fuses With a Cosmic Crystal Core
caption:
A tiny slime spirit just met a cosmic crystal core
It dives onto a golden-rune spellbook, melts into a glowing puddle, and a dark polyhedron fuses with it, rising as a core wrapped in a spinning water halo.
Best at night with the lights off - loop it and let the glow do the work.
Team slime or team crystal - which side are you on?
Save this for late nights and follow @fruit_drama_tv for more tiny spells.
